fixture.title: P45 structural maximum
fixture.coverage: Slides, element count and asset count are at the model ceiling. Artwork bytes are not: this fixture stores only the small generated PNGs below.

progress.note: The PDF path rasterizes and reports one page at a time, so its samples reach 50/50 in order. PptxGenJS builds the whole package in one pass, so the PPTX path announces rendering and then completes; its slide and media counts are asserted from the package instead.

environment.note: JS heap sampling was dropped on purpose: without --enable-precise-memory-info Chromium quantizes performance.memory, so a heap number here would not be evidence.
